description: This file implements the GroupRolesReadPlatformService interface for the Fineract project. It provides methods to retrieve group roles data from the database, including listing roles for a specific group and fetching details of a specific role within a group. It uses JDBC template for database access and includes a RowMapper implementation to map query result sets to GroupRoleData objects.

classes.name: GroupRolesReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of GroupRolesReadPlatformService, providing database access for group role data retrieval.

classes.name: GroupRolesDataMapper
classes.description: Private static inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set rows to GroupRoleData objects.

methods.name: retrieveGroupRoles
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of GroupRoleData objects for a given group ID by executing an SQL query.

methods.name: retrieveGroupRole
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific group role by group ID and role ID, throws exception if not found.
